podcast.body: A song recorded in 1968 that features four minutes of the vocable "na na na na." At 26 years old, McCartney was able to take his tenor range to a very high F for this song. "if we go back to 1968 and the recording of Hey Jude, a song that features four minutes of the vocal ball, na na na na, McCartney takes his tenor range to a very high F."

podcast.title: Songwriter
podcast.body: Paul McCartney wrote "Hey Jude" as a song of comfort for John Lennon's son, Julian. This seven-minute epic became the Beatles' single with the most weeks at number one. "Hey Jude, Paul McCartney's song of comfort for John Lennon's son, Julian."
